मौरजिक मौरजिक, अस्, m. (fr. मुरज), a
drum-beater, drummer.

मौरव मौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मुरु), coming
from or relating to the Daitya Muru.

1. मौर्व, अस्, ई, अम्, made from the iron called
मुरु.

मौर्व 2. मौर्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मूर्वा), made
of the Sanseviera Roxburghiana, coming from or
relating to मूर्वा or bow-string hemp; (ई), f. a
string or girdle made of मूर्वा, the string of inves-
titure for a Kṣatriya (Manu

मौर्ख्य मौर्ख्य, अम्, n. (fr. मूर्ख), stu-
pidity, folly, fatuity, (sometimes less correctly read
मौर्ख.)

मौर्य मौर्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from
Mura; a metronymic from Murā; N. of a dynasty
beginning with Candra-gupta.
—मौर्य-दत्त, अस्,
m. a proper N.
—मौर्य-पुत्र, अस्, m. (with
Jainas), N. of one of the eleven Gaṇādhipas.
मौर्विका, f. (in geometry) the chord of an arc.

मौर्वीक (at the end of an adj. comp.) = मौर्वी,
a bow-string.
